name: Scotty Lee Xtreme
caption: A challenger for the UXWA Universal Championship who in a June 1999 AOL roleplay says he was taught by The Reaper and is no longer afraid of him.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id 5u7149oYqy8J, 15 June 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/someone-critique-me-someone-please-1999-06-15.html. A long address to The Reaper five days before their match at Sacrifice, recounting a sneak attack on him, a retirement announcement he took back, and his claim to the Universal Title; the sign-off lists him in IWF and UXWA. The UXWA is the held wing named by the roleplay.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/someone-critique-me-someone-please-1999-06-15.html (the roleplay names the federation; dated by the post)
